create_SequenceModelOutput: create a SequenceModelOutput dataclass instance with logits tensor and pad_idx for sequence model outputs
compute_loss_nll: compute the NLL loss from SequenceModelOutput logits and target indices with optional loss mask
compute_loss_with_mask: compute the NLL loss with a loss mask to ignore specific target elements in sequence model output
compute_loss_ignore_prefix: compute the NLL loss while ignoring a prefix of steps from the beginning of the sequence
compute_loss_with_pad_idx: compute the NLL loss using pad_idx as the ignore index for padded target positions
